title: NeuroListen (Listening to the Brain): sEEG auditory-reconstruction features from 5 participants, authors' per-trial HGA/LFS/BBS arrays
description: Stereo-EEG feature arrays from five patients with epilepsy who passively listened to spoken Mandarin words, Mandarin digits and English words (2 s per stimulus). The derivative release provides per-trial high-gamma, low-frequency and broadband bipolar-referenced features at 200 Hz, repackaged in BrainVision format with the stimulus audio and mel-spectrograms. It supports research on neural decoding and auditory speech reconstruction from intracranial recordings.
methods_description: SEEG was recorded with Sinovation SDE-10/12/16 platinum-iridium shafts (118-186 contacts per participant) on a Nihon Kohden EEG-1200 at 1000 Hz. Stimuli were played from a speaker, with markers sent to a DC channel for alignment. Contacts with epileptiform activity were removed and the rest were bipolar re-referenced. High-gamma (70-150 Hz analytic amplitude), low-frequency (low-pass 100 Hz) and broadband features were computed at 200 Hz and normalised within each 2 s window.
